question: Should the bundled memory-lancedb plugin permanently expose all three auto-recall controls as independent persistent settings?
rationale: The repository sets a high bar for new config surfaces, and code review cannot decide whether operator flexibility outweighs long-term config and prompt-budget complexity.

options.title: Approve three bounded controls
options.body: Keep all three settings after integer-schema alignment, focused boundary coverage, and real live-config proof, with existing defaults unchanged.

options.title: Narrow the tuning surface
options.body: Expose one selectivity control and derive overfetch and injection limits internally to reduce persistent configuration complexity.

options.title: Keep fixed defaults
options.body: Decline the settings and retain current hardcoded behavior until a concrete operational requirement establishes the contract.

recommendation.title: Approve three bounded controls
recommendation.body: Keep all three settings after integer-schema alignment, focused boundary coverage, and real live-config proof, with existing defaults unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review and recent snapshot history make this the strongest available owner for the bundled plugin’s config-direction choice.
